# A Toil-Scanning Fixture Course

## Goal

Exercise the course-quality audit against a bundle carrying both the toil
scanner's positive and negative controls, and a coverage list with a
declared gap.

## Teaching philosophy

Small, so a test can read all of it.

## Chapter map

1. Shader basics
2. Texture work

## Topics this course must cover

- shader compilation
- depth testing
- texture sampling

## Optional lessons

`debug-overlay` is optional. It is offered after texture work, for a
learner who wants a lightweight on-screen overlay while iterating.
